summary: fix(auth): prune orphaned Redis session entries on session reads
description:
Because:
- pruneSessionTokens skips when busy or on a write conflict, leaving
  entries for deleted session tokens in Redis indefinitely.

This commit:
- Prunes cached entries with no MySQL token whenever db.sessions runs.
- Adds SessionToken.existingTokenIds to confirm deletion, since the
  findByUid listing can be truncated or omit expired tokens.
- Adds findUnlistedCachedSessionTokenIds to pick the ids to check.
- Points the skip comment in redis.ts at this retry, not the cron.

Closes FXA-14945
